page.overview:
Who is Characters?

There are hundreds of characters in the Arthurian Legends, many of whom have different spelling variations or have been renamed in different tales. This article is a list of characters who appear in the legends.

Many of the characters who do not yet have a main article on this wiki redirect here. You can help this wiki by creating/writing the page or adding to the notes in this article to help another, future editor.
